WITH region AS (
  SELECT ST_GeomFromText('POLYGON ((-85.815042 44.774572, -85.828318 44.774984, -85.937125 44.77836, -85.937178 44.771166, -85.937787 44.689175, -85.882338 44.688807, -85.878137 44.689338, -85.868025 44.689352, -85.847791 44.689383, -85.817448 44.689072, -85.817401 44.694528, -85.816567 44.725203, -85.815212 44.765215, -85.815109 44.767149, -85.815031 44.772414, -85.815042 44.774572))', 4326) AS g
),
buffered_region AS (
  SELECT
    g,
    ST_Buffer(g::geography, 100)::geometry AS g_buffer
  FROM region
),
clipped_dem AS (
  SELECT ST_Union(ST_Clip(d.rast, r.g_buffer)) AS rast
  FROM public.dem_us d
  JOIN buffered_region r
    ON ST_Intersects(d.rast, r.g_buffer)
),
slope AS (
  SELECT ST_Slope(rast, 1, '32BF', 'DEGREES', 111120) AS rast
  FROM clipped_dem
),
region_slope AS (
  SELECT ST_Clip(s.rast, r.g) AS rast
  FROM slope s, buffered_region r
)
SELECT (ST_SummaryStats(rast, 1, TRUE)).min AS slope
FROM region_slope;

  SELECT 
    ST_Clip(rast, 1, almiratownship_geom.geom, true) AS clipped_rast
